{{Quote|You've dug your own graves|Sedyn Kyne|<ref name="TOR:HR" />}}
'''Sedyn Kyne''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You owe this hunter a debt of blood, Sedyn, and I would like to see at least one of my pupils redeemed before I die.|[[Hedarr Soongh]], about the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:HR" />}}
[[File:Braden_killed.jpg|thumb|left|260px|Sedyn Kyne kills Braden and Jory]]
Kyne worked alongside [[Tarro Blood]], a noted [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who intended to enter and win the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], despite a prior failed attempt. Kyne accompanied Blood when the mercenary confronted [[Braden]] and [[Jory]] in the [[Poison Pit]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Jiguuna]], on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. On Blood's order, Kyne executed both men in the hope that their [[Death/Legends|deaths]] would cause an [[Hunter (individual)|upstart bounty hunter]] to withdraw from the Great Hunt.<ref name="TOR:TLF">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Last Flight|Hutta}}</ref>

Later, Kyne encountered the Hunter himself on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], supported by [[Hedarr Soongh]], who was aware of Blood's crimes and forced Kyne to fight a fair duel, in which the Hunter fatally shot him.<ref name="TOR:HR" />
